messages:
Ravi: Heads-up 1 Auriga QBR set for Fri. Onboarding mostly complete but FYI: overnight embed import caused a surge. Need: 1) a conservative spend forecast, 2) alert thresholds + escalation, 3) enablement checklist for their infra team. Can owners drop numbers by EOD? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Lena: I'll export last 30d token histogram + top endpoints. Initial read: nightly import + two experiment jobs. Will post in ~90m.
Diego: Quick projection from my sandbox: current retainer vs observed trend -> baseline $18.2k/mo, projected $41.7k/mo if import continues. Embeds ~70% of tokens. Suggest alerting at 60% and 85% of retainer (because they prefer tighter early-warning).
Nadia: Recommend mitigation: schedule bulk imports to off-peak window, enable prefix caching on search queries, and temporary per-endpoint cap on /bulk-embed. I can draft a throttling rule.
Tom: I'll own enablement: 45min session on batching + KV caching + small-model fallback. Plan Wed 9am PT. Need a 1-pager + sample config snippets for their infra lead.
Ravi: What's their retainer? Important for thresholds.
Tom: On file: $50k/month commit.
Diego: Using $50k -> 60% = $30k, 85% = $42.5k. So projected $41.7k is just under escalation. Recommend immediate soft alert at 30k and hard escalation when projection > 42.5k.
Lena: Pasting quick numbers (summary):
```
30d tokens: 4.2M
7d tokens: 1.2M (daily avg 171k)
Embed calls/day: 95k (up 180% WoW)
Peak spike: /bulk-embed 48k req over 3h (02:00-05:00 UTC)
```
Nadia: Drafting throttle rule: soft cap 500 req/min on /bulk-embed, queue length 200, 60s ttl, notify@auriga-eng + cs@redwood when projected > 80%.
billing-bot: projection-alert: Auriga projection crossed 60% threshold -> notified @Nadia @Ravi
Ravi: Perfect. Nadia please include escalation path: AE + finance + support on-call and an email template explaining next steps. Diego please finalize forecast table and include conservative/aggressive columns. Tom add a slide on "how to reschedule imports" and a 3-question feedback card for post-workshop.
Diego: Forecast table (quick):
```
Scenario | Monthly
Conservative (reschedule imports) | $21,500
Current trend | $41,700
Aggressive (full embed campaign) | $64,000
Alert thresholds: 60% ($30k) / 85% ($42.5k)
```
Lena: I'll attach a small log excerpt for the spike and the exact timestamps for the QBR appendix: ```[2026-03-17 02:10 UTC] /bulk-embed start -> 18k req in 40m; [2026-03-17 05:03 UTC] client paused job```
Tom: I'll draft the workshop invite + slide deck and share for review by Thu AM. Also will include the short survey: 1) Did suggested mitigations reduce friction? 2) Priority for committed pricing? 3) Other blockers to adoption.
Ravi: Good. AE note: if customer expresses willingness to commit because of predictability, Jordan (AE) should propose a staged commit with overage protection. I'll coordinate.
Nadia: One more prod ask: enable feature-flagged 256-dim embed for low-cost storage, toggleable per-project. Will log a request with eng if CS approves.
billing-bot: escalation-rule-updated: soft alerts -> emails, hard alerts -> AE + Finance pager.
Diego: Final items: I'll export CSV of daily burn and endpoint breakdown for appendix. Post when ready.
Ravi: Thanks team. QBR deck deadline: Thu COB for internal review, Fri for customer. Ping me if blocked. :rocket:
